== Issues ==

=== All Mute issues, chronologically (table) ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="sparql">
#defaultView:Table
# Every Mute issue in publication order. Properties used:
#   P2 Mute issue ID, P4 title, P5 volume, P6 issue number, P7 publication date,
#   P9 issue ISSN token, P10 ISBN-13, P12 described at URL, P16 sort key, P17 QA status.
# Publication dates have month precision; the sort key (P16, chronological then printed
# order) breaks ties and keeps issues of the same month in print order.
# The prefix is written out so the query works whatever the installation's concept URI is.
PREFIX wdt: <https://corpus.metamute.org/prop/direct/>
SELECT ?issue ?issueLabel ?month ?volume ?number ?title ?issueId ?issnToken ?isbn ?url ?qaStatus
WHERE {
  ?issue wdt:P2 ?issueId ;
         wdt:P5 ?volume ;
         wdt:P6 ?number ;
         wdt:P7 ?date ;
         wdt:P16 ?sortKey ;
         rdfs:label ?issueLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?issueLabel) = "en")
  OPTIONAL { ?issue wdt:P4 ?title }
  OPTIONAL { ?issue wdt:P9 ?issnToken }
  OPTIONAL { ?issue wdt:P10 ?isbn }
  OPTIONAL { ?issue wdt:P12 ?url }
  OPTIONAL { ?issue wdt:P17 ?qaStatus }
  BIND(SUBSTR(STR(?date), 1, 7) AS ?month)
}
ORDER BY ?date ?sortKey
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Number of issues per volume ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="sparql">
#defaultView:Table
PREFIX wdt: <https://corpus.metamute.org/prop/direct/>
SELECT ?volume (COUNT(?issue) AS ?issues) (MIN(?date) AS ?first) (MAX(?date) AS ?last)
WHERE {
  ?issue wdt:P2 ?issueId ;
         wdt:P5 ?volume ;
         wdt:P7 ?date .
}
GROUP BY ?volume
ORDER BY ?volume
</syntaxhighlight>
